current_run_recovery: The existing usage ledger alone cannot reconstruct the lost names or review approvals. Unless root finds separately preserved real request/response artifacts, record those tokens as spent and do not manufacture recovered decisions or make new paid calls beyond the unchanged budget.
minimum_boundaries: Use the existing private Stage filesystem and atomic-write pattern, after the real producer/reviewer operation has completed, validation and qualified-template checks pass, and before the next paid request. No new database tables/service or publication-state writes; hold no database transaction across network calls.

Store the original complete decision unchanged, including producer/reviewer IDs, timestamps, usage, sources with original retrieval timestamps/content hashes, methods, optional note, finite source_items, and review.content_sha256. Preserve the supplied source-evidence snapshot and template context separately as actual request inputs; do not claim unseen inputs were sent to the model.

Bind the checkpoint to kind/key, exact finite source_items including SGF hashes/slots, actual evidence snapshot and current template constraints, using a deterministic bounded intent/content hash. Check for a hit before refreshing Wikipedia evidence; reuse the saved evidence snapshot instead of replacing its retrieval time or text. Never reuse by display/name string alone.

On load, recheck validate_decision/content hash, exact current finite membership and SGF hashes, current candidate rules and current qualified-template constraints. Keep fresh TEST/PROD identity and scope preflight. Corruption or changed context is never accepted as an approved hit.

Scope shrink/expansion, changed source evidence or template meaning cannot reuse the old approval. A real narrowed review may use the existing review_existing_decision path; persist its independently approved result separately. The minimal first patch may treat non-exact matches as misses, retaining prior artifacts without granting broader reuse.

Persist completed narrowed reviews as well as initial complete decisions. Budget/transport/deadline cancellation leaves earlier completed checkpoints usable; an incomplete producer-only call is not an approved decision and need not introduce a new partial-review state.

Do not raise budgets, reset or reimburse the durable token ledger, weaken reservations, mark items names_ready/published from checkpoints, or emit an incomplete package. Preserve current deferral and resume normal publication only after full manifest validation.
minimum_verification: Existing focused preparation test: first decision succeeds, next request defers for budget; a second process/preparation reuses the exact stored decision without a paid call for it and eventually validates the complete manifest.
Focused parameter cases: changed finite membership/SGF or template context misses; tampered decision/hash is rejected. Original sources and real reviewer metadata remain unchanged on a hit.

Budget or cancellation during a later call/narrowed review preserves earlier complete checkpoints, creates no unreviewed partial package, and leaves existing ledger accounting intact. Reuse the existing ledger tests rather than building another test layer.
preferred_fix: Persist each complete, validated reviewed decision as a narrowly bound private Stage checkpoint, then reuse only an exactly matching finite request on retry. Keep existing all-or-nothing manifest preparation and native publication guards.

reported_live_context.source: root actual run62158 summary; not independently queried by this review

root_cause.fact: Audit records request identity and usage metadata, not candidate/reviewer response bodies.
A complete validated decision returns to the caller without durable storage.
Approved decisions accumulate in a local list. A later NameServiceError escapes before any manifest is returned.
NameServiceError defers the group; package persistence occurs only after successful preparation.

scope: Observed normal run62158 loss of completed reviewed decisions after later budget deferral; implementation not yet reviewed or executed.
why_not_partial_freeze: Already approved decisions can span games that still lack another name. Native validation requires every signed source_item to be present. Freezing an arbitrary completed subset would require scope closure or fresh narrowed reviews, which may themselves need unavailable tokens; that is not the smallest fix for losing completed work.
